findings.title: Prompt tests lack reproducible command and exit-status records
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3: “It records every prompt TEST with its exact command or inspection procedure, exit status, material output, and a PASS or FAIL conclusion supported by that evidence.”
findings.trigger: A reviewer attempts to reproduce or audit Tests 1–5 from the report.
findings.consequence: The prose procedures do not identify the exact commands used and generally provide no per-command exit statuses, so the reported PASS conclusions cannot be traced to complete execution evidence. Test 6 also has no recorded exit status or PASS/FAIL result.
findings.evidence: Section 3 gives narrative procedures such as “Loaded…,” “Inspected…,” and “Created two independent…,” but not exact commands or exit statuses. Section 7 supplies one exact pytest command and summary only; it says Test 6 will run later.

findings.title: Rollback checkpoint was not verified using the specified rollback procedure
findings.criterion_ref: Criteria 4 and 6 require demonstration that the rollback procedure was honored and “the verification result at the rollback checkpoint.”
findings.trigger: The report is used to establish that reverting P01 restores the P00-verifiable state.
findings.consequence: No executed rollback or post-rollback P00 inventory reproducibility result exists, leaving the required rollback checkpoint unverified.
findings.evidence: Section 4 states: “Rollback was not actually executed… only confirmed exercisable by path analysis.” Section 6 repeats: “exercisable, not executed.” The prompt specifies rollback as a revert followed by the P00 inventory reproducibility test.

findings.title: Post-change status and immutable evidence are incomplete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 6: “It includes the post-change git status and a reviewable diff or immutable digest for every deliverable.”
findings.trigger: A reviewer uses Section 6 to reconstruct the complete final working-tree state or verify all checkpoint deliverables.
findings.consequence: The recorded status omits a modified tracked file, and several listed checkpoint outputs have neither a reviewable diff nor an immutable digest, so the final delta cannot be fully verified.
findings.evidence: Actual `git status --short --untracked-files=all` includes `M plans_internal/refactor_repo/prompts/generated/P02S_structured_data_codemod.prompt.v4.yaml`, which Section 6’s status does not show. Sections 2 and 6 list the report and three execution-journal files as checkpoint outputs, but provide digests only for `pyproject.toml`, `MANIFEST.in`, `src/curriculum_factory/__init__.py`, and the focused test file.

observations: The report correctly refrains from claiming that the independent QA gate has already passed, so no separate Criterion 7 finding is raised.
reasoning: The artifact contains substantial narrative evidence, but three explicit evidence requirements remain unsatisfied: exact test execution records, an executed rollback verification, and complete final-state/deliverable evidence. Each is mandatory under the stated criteria and cannot be cured by interpreting the prose as an equivalent preference or hardening measure.
